description.zh: 文件里电子邮件地址所在的列，从1开始索引
description.en: The column that contains the email addresses in the file. The index starts from 1.
The name of the file that contains the list of email addresses.
The URL of the file that contains the list of email addresses.
Specifies whether the first row is a table header.

description.zh: 输出文件结果里是否需要对电子邮件进行去重
description.en: Specifies whether to remove duplicate email addresses in the output file.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm send-validate-file --file-url http://xxxx.oss-xxx.com/file.txt --file-name file.txt --address-column 1 --has-header-row false --remove-duplicate true --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm SendValidateFile --region cn-hangzhou --AddressColumn 1 --FileUrl 'http://xxxx.oss-xxx.com/file.txt' --HasHeaderRow false --FileName 'file.txt' --RemoveDuplicate true
